one_liner: Meta's Marketing API (Graph API) for Facebook/Instagram ads is broad, OAuth2-capable and has an official hosted MCP server, but meaningful multi-user use needs app review and business verification.
auth_notes: Facebook Login OAuth authorization-code flow (with ads_management/ads_read scopes) is used for multi-user access. Long-lived user tokens (about 60 days) and non-expiring system user tokens are static tokens users can generate.
access_notes: Developer app creation is self-serve and free, and calls are free. Managing other people's ad accounts needs App Review, Business Verification and Advanced Access for permissions. Marketing API Access Tier moves from Limited to Full, which needs 500 calls in 15 days with an error rate under 15%.
blocker_notes: Builders can test on their own ad accounts with app-role users. Production multi-user OAuth needs Meta App Review, Business Verification and Marketing API Full Access tier.

evidence.quote: Every Marketing API call requires an access token as a parameter.
Redirect the user to Meta's OAuth dialog:
Depending on your intended use case, you may need to submit your app for review to gain access to specific permissions related to ad management.
Have successfully made at least 500 Marketing API calls in the last 15 days.
Meta charges nothing for the calls; for your own ad account an app with basic access is enough, while managing other people’s accounts needs app review and business verification.
Manage an unlimited number of ad accounts, assuming you get `ads_read` or `ads_management` permission from the ad account.
the set of Graph API endpoints at `graph.facebook.com` that create, change, and report on ads across Facebook, Instagram, and Meta's other apps.
The server is remote-hosted at `https://mcp.facebook.com/ads` and works with any MCP-compatible AI agent.
Meta runs official remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that bring Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Meta Ads capabilities to your agentic workflows.
